title: lore agents --check fails: .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md is out-of-date-protected on dev
description: Discovered incidentally while verifying QCLI-232 (unrelated .codex/ cleanup): 'lore agents --check' has been exit 6 on dev independent of that work, reporting '.claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md' as out-of-date-protected (differs from what lore would currently generate; 'protected' means lore will not overwrite it without --force, in case the difference is a deliberate hand-edit). Confirmed via git stash against the pre-QCLI-232 tree, so this predates and is unrelated to this session's fleet-cutover work. Not fixed here since it's unclear without investigation whether the current file content is a deliberate customization worth preserving or simple version drift safe to regenerate with lore agents --force.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Diff the current .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md against what lore agents --force would generate, and determine whether the difference is deliberate local customization or simple staleness
lore agents --check exits 0 (either by regenerating with --force, or by recording why the protected difference should stand and updating the check/expectation accordingly)
